libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: The javac failure is caused solely by org.xerial.snappy.SnappyLoader.isNativeLibraryLoaded() being removed in 1.1.0.1 (replaced internally by a private `isLoaded` field with no public accessor); getVersion(), KEY_SNAPPY_TEMPDIR, and KEY_SNAPPY_USE_SYSTEMLIB are unchanged. Update the two call sites in SnappyLoaderTest.java to stop calling the removed method — verify native loading indirectly (e.g. via successful Snappy.compress/uncompress and/or Snappy.getNativeLibraryVersion()) instead of asserting the old boolean return. Separately, snappy-java bundles per-OS/arch JNI libraries inside the jar under org/xerial/snappy/native/<os>/<arch>/; this is NOT part of the normal generated scaffold. Preserve the existing build.gradle's extractSnappyNativeLibrary Copy task, the `-Djava.library.path=<extracted dir>` and `--add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED` test jvmArgs, and the matching `--add-opens` native-image buildArg — the resource layout is unchanged in 1.1.0.1 so this logic carries over unmodified.
